release_notes: Vidrick AI Transcriber 4.1.4 improves offline speaker diarization and speaker-turn consistency while preserving the existing transcription engine and fully local workflow. The update improves short speaker handoffs, prevents the global speaker decoder from over-collapsing two-person conversations into a single speaker, adds within-segment speaker boundary detection, validates speaker boundaries using conversational context, improves continuity across fragmentary turns, and strengthens speaker identity stability when a speaker is established early in a conversation. Transcription, licensing, activation, portal integration, payments, updater behavior, and existing legal content remain unchanged.
